name: vitals
description: A framed live dashboard above the prompt, in the terminal and in the desktop app: model and reasoning effort, context and plan-limit meters, cost, tokens in/out with cache read/write and hit rate per turn and per session, every subagent with its model, effort, tokens and tools, background shells, tools running now and tool counts. /vitals switches to one compact line, /vitals pane opens the full history.

cache_ttl.title: Prompt-cache TTL
cache_ttl.description: How long the main conversation's prompt cache lives: 1h or 5m (anything else counts as 1h). The band marks the cache cold after this much idle time. 1h on a Claude subscription within plan usage; 5m with API billing, a cloud provider or usage credits.
